home.valueTitle: Why this can work for you
home.valueSubtitle: Each phase has its own page—you are not trapped on one endless marketing scroll.

values.v1Body: The AI is meant to work from templates and explicit decisions—fewer painful revision loops.
values.v2Body: Tap-to-answer briefing captures what you want. You can adjust later without starting from zero.
values.v3Body: You mark sections, comment, and improve—nothing goes live without a deliberate approval.
values.v4Body: Performance, backups, and billing sit with the partner. We keep the chain short and explain what happens where.

home.proofBody: We document the flow carefully and expand pages once the builder is publicly testable. Case studies and metrics only arrive when we can measure them properly.
home.storyTitle: Why a clear path reduces stress
home.storyP1: Many projects fail not because of “missing AI” but missing context: what you offer, for whom, and which pages you truly need. Without that, every layout becomes guesswork.
home.storyP2: site24.com is meant to guide you step by step: understand first, ask structured questions, then show proposals you deliberately accept or reject. Only then do you move to domain, hosting, and day‑two operations with your provider.
home.storyP3: You stay in control of content and publication—the AI adds speed and variants, not a substitute for your decisions.
home.testimonialsDisclaimer: No real customer quotes yet: the statements below are placeholders to clarify tone and expected benefits. Once we have measurable outcomes and consent, we will replace them with real stories.
home.quote1Text: I did not want another endless template scroll. The clear questions helped me decide what must be on the homepage.
home.quote2Text: I cared that hosting and billing do not chain to yet another tool. The split to the provider made sense.
home.quote3Text: I do not expect a #1 guarantee—but I want headings, meta text, and load time as explicit goals.
home.metricsSubtitle: No invented conversion rates—these are framework facts for the planned product and this site. Measurable KPIs ship with launch.
home.seoPrinciplesTitle: Technical SEO as a target—including sites from the builder
home.seoPrinciplesLead: The future builder should output pages search engines can parse and users are not slowed down by. That does not replace content strategy and does not guarantee rankings.
home.seoPrinciplesItem1: Sensible heading hierarchy (one h1 per page, meaningful h2/h3) and descriptive internal links.
home.seoPrinciplesItem2: Distinct titles and meta descriptions per page—approved by you, not silently overwritten.
home.seoPrinciplesItem3: Clean URLs and consistent language versions (hreflang / separate paths, like /de and /en here).
home.seoPrinciplesItem4: Performance-minded markup: lean assets, sensible image sizes, Core Web Vitals in mind.
home.seoPrinciplesItem5: Search-friendly extra page metadata where it makes sense—without gimmicks.
home.seoPrinciplesItem6: Accessibility and readability (contrast, focus states, meaningful alt text).
home.seoPrinciplesDisclaimer: Rankings depend on competition, content, links, and technical health. We do not promise top positions; we promise a transparent technical foundation you can understand.

productPage.featuresSubtitle: Everything follows one rule: you decide; the software guides and records.
productPage.f1Body: Free text and prompts capture offer, audience, and tone—so proposals fit you, not a generic industry template.
productPage.f2Body: Short questions with tap-to-answer choices—not a yes/no grid. That keeps your site's message clear.

productPage.f4Body: Most steps stay no-code. When you need HTML/CSS or snippets, it should be explicit—not a forced developer track.
productPage.f5Body: You mark sections, leave feedback, and compare states before you approve.
productPage.f6Body: Export, checklist, and partner link—so domain, TLS, and billing live where law and support expect them.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.statusBanner: Legal note: this statement is not a substitute for individual legal review. Update it as soon as you process personal data (accounts, newsletters, analytics, AI processing).
privacyPage.lead: We take privacy seriously. On the current informational site we do not set non-essential marketing cookies and we do not run newsletter tracking. If that changes, we will update this page and obtain consent where required before setting non-essential cookies.
privacyPage.s1Body: This statement applies to the website at site24.com on the linked domain. Version: May 2026. Changes will be documented here.
privacyPage.s2Body: The controller under GDPR is the legal or natural person named in the legal notice. While only placeholder data is shown, contact the email address listed there for privacy requests.
privacyPage.s3Body: The site is operated with a hosting provider. When you access pages, technically necessary data (e.g., IP address, timestamp, user agent, requested resource) may be processed in server log files. Purpose: secure operation, abuse detection, error analysis. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) lit. f GDPR (legitimate interest in a secure web offering). Retention depends on the provider; add concrete periods from your data processing agreement.
privacyPage.s4Body: If you email us, we process the data you send (at minimum email address, content, metadata) to handle your request. Legal basis: Art. 6 (1) lit. b GDPR for pre-contractual steps, or lit. f for general inquiries.
privacyPage.s5Body: Currently this informational site does not use optional marketing or analytics cookies that would require consent under ePrivacy rules. If we introduce consent management or analytics, we will document vendor, purpose, retention, and legal basis here and obtain consent before setting non-essential cookies.
privacyPage.s6Body: Once an AI builder is active, content you enter may be transmitted to processors (e.g., model providers). We will describe in advance which data is processed for which purpose, in which regions, and whether EU standard contractual clauses apply. We will not start productive processing without that transparency.
privacyPage.s7Body: We store personal data only as long as needed for the respective purpose or as required by statutory retention periods. Details will follow per feature in tabular form.
privacyPage.s8Body: Where legal requirements are met, you have rights to access (Art. 15 GDPR), rectification (Art. 16), erasure (Art. 17), restriction (Art. 18), data portability (Art. 20), and objection (Art. 21). You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR).
privacyPage.s9Body: You may complain to the supervisory authority responsible for us. For Germany, an overview is available at https://www.bfdi.bund.de/DE/Infothek/Anschriften_Links/anschriften_links-node.html (external link).
privacyPage.s10Body: If our processing changes (new features, new vendors), we will update this statement and change the date. For material changes we will also inform you prominently on the site.
